The inquiry is examining the impact of the Support at Home program, which launched in November 2025 and has been plagued by complaints of making care harder to… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Report finds Support at Home co-payments should be reviewed
item.description: The amount older Australians contribute to Support at Home services should be reviewed and clinicians should be able to override the assessment algorithms, a parliamentary committee recommends. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: The 3.3 tonnes of drugs were found on an unflagged tanker, which experts have dubbed a "mothership". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Jannik Sinner is ruled out of the Australian Open in January following an operation on his knee. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Australia’s Digital Duty of Care law: Why Big Tech is under pressure
item.description: The law places a legal duty on online services to protect users from serious harm; but the conservative opposition and the United States say the law could lead to censorship of lawful speech Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.description: The inquest into a detainee who died by suicide hears police did not pass on critical information to prison staff which would have likely placed him on an at-risk mental health system. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Tasmania Police name the man they believe shot Sergeant Michael Preshaw on Saturday night on Flinders Island as Jordan Jeffrey Willis. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sending an Australian astronaut to space is expensive. How do we work out if it's worth it?
item.description: Australia is currently in talks with the European Space Agency (ESA) over potentially flying Katherine Bennell-Pegg on a future space mission. If accepted, Bennell-Pegg—who is the director of space technology at the Australian Space Agency and completed ESA training in 2024—would become the first officially funded Australian astronaut. Fuente: Phys.org.
